headline: KIM JAE WON teases 'Line1' ahead of Nov 29 release
caption:
KIM JAE WON (Kimis06) has dropped a teaser for his new song 'Line1' (1호선).

The teaser was unveiled on 1theK's official YouTube channel, and the full release is set for Nov 29. Named after Seoul's Subway Line 1, the track lands tomorrow!

📌 Source: 1theK official YouTube
